nonClaims: This register is not an independent fresh review verdict.

newFacts: Five no-PMCID PubMed/DOI source families remain manual/fulltext-access routes only and cannot fill artifacts in this pass.
The ER-Golgi trafficking source is shared across EXT-008 and EXT-009; EXT-009 must remain duplicate/source-lineage context unless fresh review selects a bounded vocabulary-only role.
Intercompartmental communication in senescence has an open PMC fulltext route for the EXT-010 primary source line and can enter bounded fresh review through paired PubMed/PMC routes.
The EXT-013 organelle-contact route reuses PMC13145362 and must not be counted as independent evidence before fresh review collapses duplicate lineage.
summary.nextWorkOrder: Run independent fresh review over the fourteen manual extraction rows; only two rows can be considered bounded artifact-prep candidates before review, and all model admission gates remain blocked.
